stemMd: Choose the most concise replacement for the bracketed words without losing meaning: "The committee [reached a unanimous agreement that every member supported] to keep the garden open."

options.label: A
options.textMd: agreed that some members supported the decision

options.label: B
options.textMd: reached an agreement in a unanimous manner that all supported

options.label: D
options.textMd: made an agreement that was unanimous among all of the members

explanationMd: Unanimously already means with agreement by everyone. "Agreed unanimously" preserves the full meaning while removing repeated descriptions of the same support.

distractorRationale.b: This repeats unanimity in several phrases.
distractorRationale.d: This retains the same unnecessary repetition.
distractorRationale.a: This changes unanimity into partial support.
